notes.title: RELEASE ON OCTOBER 6TH!!
notes.notes:
Hi!

It feels great to finally break the silence and tell you all the latest Carimara news! Let’s start with a big one: we just announced on IGN Live that CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs will be launching on Steam on October 6th!  

Please check out the new trailer, I personally love it !

[previewyoutube=rCQow2QOFs0;full][/previewyoutube]

You may recall that previously I mentioned working with an interesting publisher, so today I can also tell who they are: it’s CRITICAL REFLEX, the folks behind BUCKSHOT ROULETTE, Mouthwashing, No I’m Not a Human and more!

With their help I was able to add a few more secrets in Carimara and I hope together we can make its story reach the hearts of players all around the world! Especially now that Carimara has a much bigger pool of supported languages! 😁

And to make these few extra weeks of waiting a bit more bearable, I plan to write devlogs about Carimara every now and again, so please stay tuned for that.

Thank you for stopping by! It’s been a pleasure to see you all again, and I’ll be happy to see you here again on October 6th when Carimara finally launches on Steam!!

Remember, little Carimara, you fate is in the cards,
Bastinus Rex & CRITICAL REFLEX

notes.title: RELEASE POSTPONED TO SUMMER
notes.notes:
I can't wait to tell you the name of the publisher, I hope it'll happen soon.
The game is basically ready, and I'm taking advantage of the extra time I have to add a few little secrets!
Take care,

Bastinus rex
